scenes.say: Double your bet after every loss and you'll always win it back. Except you absolutely won't.
Martingale wins small, wins often. That's exactly what makes it dangerous.
{players} players on red, win chance {m_p}, bankroll {m_start}, starting bet {m_stake}.
After {rounds} spins, {m_ruin} of the doublers are broke.
Flat bettors in the same game: {f_ruin}.
Doubling doesn't change the odds. It trades lots of small wins for one loss that takes almost everything.
No betting system turns a losing game into a winning one. It only changes the shape of the loss.

takeaway: No betting system turns a losing game into a winning one. It only changes the shape of the loss.
